name: BabyMonitor
description: Monitors audio from an RTSP camera stream and sends alerts to Home Assistant when noise exceeds a configurable threshold. Designed for baby monitoring but works with any RTSP camera. Uses FFmpeg ebur128 filter for accurate volume measurement. Publishes live volume to MQTT and fires a Home Assistant webhook when noise is detected. Features dual camera fallback on connection loss, auto-reconnect, and configurable threshold + trigger count to avoid false positives. No code changes needed — fully configured via environment variables.

variables.name: Primary Camera URL
variables.description: Primary RTSP stream URL — e.g. rtsp://user:pass@192.168.1.x:554/stream

variables.name: Fallback Camera URL
variables.description: Secondary RTSP URL — used automatically when the primary fails (optional)

variables.name: Noise Threshold (dBFS)
variables.description: Volume threshold in dBFS. Higher = more sensitive. Silent room: -60 to -45. Baby crying: -20 to -10. Start at -30 and adjust.

variables.name: Trigger Count
variables.description: Consecutive loud readings required before alert fires — avoids false positives from brief sounds

variables.name: MQTT Topic
variables.description: Topic for live volume readings (used for MQTT sensor in HA)

variables.name: HA Webhook URL
variables.description: Home Assistant webhook URL to call when noise is detected

variables.name: Retry Delay (s)
variables.description: Seconds to wait before reconnecting after camera connection loss
